newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Baby born in Malaysian Prime Minister's office.
newsitem.headline: Baby born in Malaysian Prime Minister's office.

text.p: Malaysian Prime Minister Mahathir Mohamad's special police escort cleared clogged Kuala Lumpur roads on Wednesday to take a baby girl born in the Prime Minister's office to hospital.

The national news agency Bernama reported that 32-year-old Wan Mimi Wan Omar, an employee in Mahathir's office, began experiencing labour pains at around 2.00 p.m. (0600 GMT) and delivered the baby about five minutes later.
A programmer acted as midwife while waiting for an ambulance to arrive. He then took Omar to hospital in an office car, escorted by Mahathir's outriders.
Mahathir was resting at home after returning from a trip to the United States and Japan early on Wednesday.
